## Summary

Three bugs found while dogfooding `quorum serve` on the Compass UI.

### 1. Slowness — `detectProvider()` running twice per request

`compass.js run()` called `detectProvider()` internally — re-running all CLI probes (1.5s Ollama timeout, keychain `security` check, file reads) on **every** compass request.

Fix: `compass.js run()` now accepts an `injectedLlm` parameter. `toolCompass` passes `_llm` directly, skipping detection entirely.
